records.title: Engaging with Music
records.header: MUHST 100 Engaging with Music (3) A&H
records.text: MUHST 100 Engaging with Music (3) A&H Helps students understand their experiences making music in its broadest social and historical contexts. Includes hands-on projects involving personal, local, and university histories with music, as well as current events. Offered: W.

records.title: Gender and Music
records.header: MUHST 422 Gender and Music (3) A&H/SSc, DIV
records.text: MUHST 422 Gender and Music (3) A&H/SSc, DIV Investigates how gender issues have shaped the creation and perception of music; introduces women composers and their music. Topics include writing women's biography; creation of the music canon; gender issues in opera; intertwining issues of race, class, and gender, blues women; and popular music. Prerequisite: minimum grade of 2.0 in each of MUHST 210, MUSIC 303, and MUSIC 306. Offered: W.
